dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, who do you have in the Masters tier?

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: Our very own Grand Master Varka's one of 'em, for sure! As for others...

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: In all our time during the expedition to Nod-Krai, the only other one we've met who can compare is the head of the Fatui Harbingers.

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: But annoyingly, he's also referred to as "The Captain," which makes discussions about battle power quite confusing, especially with the Captains tier! Ugh!
